#!/bin/sh
# Main exact-six CC-CAM route; current global native is the full suffix.
if [ "$#" -ge 3 ] && [ "$1" = experiment ]; then
  case "$3" in
    EP_PERF_CC_CAM_VECTOR4M_F_1275_V1|EP_PERF_CC_CAM_VECTOR4M_F_1700_V1|EP_PERF_CC_CAM_VECTOR4M_F_850_V1|EP_PERF_CC_CAM_VECTOR4M_S_1275_V1|EP_PERF_CC_CAM_VECTOR4M_S_1700_V1|EP_PERF_CC_CAM_VECTOR4M_S_850_V1)
      if [ "$#" -ne 5 ] || [ "$4" != --project ] || [ "$5" != EP_L2 ]; then
        printf '%s\n' 'CC_CAM_NATIVE_HOLD exact5/project required' >&2; exit 2
      fi
      case "$2" in prepare|inspect|run-native|accept) ;;
        *) printf '%s\n' 'CC_CAM_NATIVE_HOLD unsupported operation' >&2; exit 2;;
      esac
      export EP_FULL_PERF_NATIVE_ENTRY=1
      exec /usr/bin/python3 -B /root/data/ep_l2_full_workload_performance_20261027_v1/research/performance_first_v2_20261103_v1/activation_20261104_v1/agent_b_binding/qualified_runtime/ep_perf_frontend.py "$@"
      ;;
  esac
fi
printf '%s\n' 'CC_CAM_NATIVE_HOLD outside exact scoped request' >&2
exit 2
